title: 第16章 裂缝第17章 藤蔓
content_zh:
第16章裂缝
杜成金忍不住好奇，轻声问前面的虎镇华道：“虎堂主，这山洞已经到尽头了啊，那密地在什么地方？”
“不要多问，你等着就是了。”虎镇华冷声道。
也不知是那虎镇华不耐烦多说，还是他自己也不知道，一句话就把杜成金给打发了。虎镇华都是这个态度，问虎镇嵩和那几位仙师就更不用说了，其他人顿时打消了念头，周围也随之陷入了沉寂。
安静的山洞似乎没有一点危险，但是大家的心情却始终都沉闷无比，时间越长，他们越是觉得似乎有巨大的危险在等着大家。可事已至此，反悔是不可能的，也只能坚持到底。
又过了将近半个时辰，大家都等的有点不耐烦了，忽然，前面传来嗡的一声轻响，大家连忙往前看，只见那墙壁上不知何时竟然泛起了一丝光芒。这光芒很是微弱，若不是因为大家都站在跟前，又是耳聪目明的江湖中人，很难发现其中的变化。
随后那道光芒的面积越来越大，渐渐地竟然变成了一道足有一寸宽裂缝。是的，就是裂缝，甚至能隐隐约约的看到裂缝的后面，谁都没有想到，石壁上竟然会突兀的出现一道裂缝。
随着裂缝的扩大，忽然一股淡淡的轻烟从那裂缝之中透出来，朝着前面的一众江湖人士扑面而来。
在场的都是老江湖了，虽然做了一些必要应对，但是对这种蹊跷的变化还是有些估计不足，而且这轻烟出现的太过突然，又无色无味无法阻挡，猝不及防之下顿时就吸入了一些。
大家顿时脸上色变，这轻烟之中要是有毒，大家岂不是都要命丧这个山洞？难道几位仙师找大家过来就是为了试毒？
他们回头看了看，发现事情并不是如此，后面的几位仙师似乎也吸入了不少的轻烟，但是他们不但没有露出焦急或者懊恼之色，脸上反而有一种不自然的陶醉之色，这是怎么回事？
随后大家就感觉出来了，那轻烟并没有什么毒副作用，似乎对身体还有一些好处，浑身的疲惫一扫而光。尤其是有内伤的钱半仙，深深的吸上一口，感觉体内的伤势似乎都轻了一些。
青阳他们不知道，那裂缝之中泄露出来的一股轻烟，其实是修仙者不可或缺的灵气。除了修仙者占据的洞天福地之外，外界的灵气一般很稀少，几位仙师出门在外，修炼条件恶劣，已经很长时间没有接触到如此浓郁的灵气，这才会显得如此陶醉。
除了习有修仙功法的修仙者，普通人是无法吸收炼化灵气的，但也不能说灵气对普通人无用，若是长期生活在灵气更加浓郁的地方，普通人的身体素质和各方面能力都会有潜移默化的提高。只不过这个过程太过缓慢，一般人很难察觉，也就是在场的这些江湖中人感知灵敏，又是第一次接触到如此浓郁的灵气，才会有那种错觉。
眼看着裂缝已经出现，距离正午时辰也差不多了，后面的溪英仙师大喝一声：“其他人闪开，溪平、溪宁一起动手！”
大家不明白几位仙师要干什么，但也知道不能怠慢，于是连忙两旁退了几步，把中间的位置让给了三位仙师。
这时，就见那溪平仙师右手一招，一柄小巧的金色飞剑就出现在了他的手心。那飞剑迎风而涨，转眼之间就变成了一尺多长，金灿灿的，发出耀眼的光芒。随后溪平仙师手一挥，那金色飞剑就像是有了生命一般，竟然自己朝着那裂缝斩了过去。
与此同时，另一侧的溪宁仙师也召出了一盏红色的油灯，也不知他做了什么动作，那油灯嗡的一声轻响，燃起了一道通红的火焰。随后溪宁仙师对着油灯轻轻一吹，那通红的火焰顿时就飞到了裂缝之上，整个裂缝都开始燃烧了起来。
看着眼前这一幕，青阳等一众江湖人士都惊得目瞪口呆，遥控飞剑，隔空取火，这也太神奇了吧？怪不得大家那么羡慕仙师，这些手段真是厉害，比起传说中的神仙也丝毫不差啊。
那通红的火焰，隔了这么远，大家都能感觉到上面炙热的温度，这要是碰上一丝，估计转眼之间就能被燃成灰烬。至于那金灿灿的飞剑，就厉害了，带着浓郁的杀气，挨着就死，擦着就亡，江湖人士面对这种手段，根本就无力反抗，逃跑都没用。看着这一切，青阳的心中越发的火热。

那裂缝似乎很有弹性，被飞剑和火焰同时击中，他只是轻轻一荡，就卸掉了大部分的攻击，剩下的力道也只是令裂缝的宽度增加了不到一指宽，之后随着攻击力的丧失，那裂缝竟然又开始慢慢的愈合。
就在这时，溪英仙师双掌齐出，快速的做了一个复杂的法诀，一团青色的能量在他手中形成，随后轻轻一甩，正撞在了那裂缝之上。
溪英仙师的功力确实强大，虽然只是徒手发出的攻击，没有借助什么兵器，但是威力却比溪平、溪宁两位仙师加在一起还大，只是这么一掌，就把那道裂缝扩大到了两寸宽。
溪英仙师的攻击刚刚完成，另两位仙师的攻击又接踵而至，他们分成两拨，不停地发动攻击，根本就不给那裂缝复原的机会。没过多久，那道裂缝就渐渐地扩展到了一尺多宽，足够一个人走过去。
到了这时候，那溪英仙师的情况还好一些，溪平仙师和溪宁仙师已经额头见汗，体内的元气已经消耗了一大半。他们的修为毕竟低一些，还不足以支撑他们长时间的消耗。
又一次轮到溪英仙师攻击了，这一次他却没有在发动攻击，而是摸出两颗黑色的种子随手扔在了前面，随后两根手臂粗的藤蔓突兀的长了出来。那藤蔓越长越大，渐渐的竟然伸到了裂缝之中，随后两根藤蔓上又冒出无数的枝条，相互缠绕拉扯，撕扯着那道裂缝。
随着藤蔓的长大，溪英仙师的脸上终于露出了一丝苍白，这是元气过渡消耗的特征，由此可见，操纵这藤蔓生长，并且撑起前面那道裂缝，对于溪英仙师这样的人来说也是很耗费功力的。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 16 Crack
Du Chengjin couldn't help but be curious and asked Hu Zhenhua in front of him softly: "Master Hu, this cave has reached the end. Where is the secret place?"
"Don't ask any more questions, just wait." Hu Zhenhua said coldly.
I don't know whether Hu Zhenhua was impatient to say more, or he didn't know it himself, but he dismissed Du Chengjin with just one sentence. Hu Zhenhua had this attitude, let alone Hu Zhensong and those immortal masters. The others immediately gave up their thoughts, and the surroundings fell into silence.
There seemed to be no danger in the quiet cave, but everyone was always in a dull mood. The longer the time passed, the more they felt that there seemed to be a huge danger waiting for everyone. But the matter has come to this, it is impossible to regret, and we can only persist to the end.
After nearly half an hour, everyone was getting a little impatient. Suddenly, there was a soft buzzing sound in front of them. Everyone quickly looked forward and saw a ray of light on the wall. This light is very weak. If it weren't for everyone standing in front of it and being a person with sharp ears and eyes, it would be difficult to detect the change.
Then the area of ​​​​that ray of light became larger and larger, and gradually turned into a crack that was an inch wide. Yes, it was a crack. You could even vaguely see the back of the crack. No one expected that a crack would suddenly appear on the stone wall.
As the crack expanded, a faint puff of smoke suddenly emerged from the crack and rushed toward the people in the arena in front.
All the people present were old Jianghu. Although they had taken some necessary measures, they still underestimated this strange change. Moreover, the light smoke appeared too suddenly and was colorless and odorless. It was unstoppable, so I was caught off guard and inhaled some of it.
Everyone's faces suddenly changed. If the smoke was poisonous, wouldn't everyone die in this cave? Could it be that these immortal masters came here just to test the poison?
They looked back and found that this was not the case. The immortal masters behind seemed to have inhaled a lot of light smoke. However, instead of showing any signs of anxiety or annoyance, they had an unnatural look of intoxication on their faces. What was going on?
Then everyone felt that the light smoke had no side effects and seemed to have some benefits for the body, and all the fatigue was swept away. Especially Qian Banxian, who had internal injuries. He took a deep breath and felt that the injuries in his body seemed to be lighter.
Qingyang and the others didn't know that the light smoke leaking out of the crack was actually the indispensable spiritual energy for immortal cultivators. Except for the blessed land of cave heaven occupied by immortal cultivators, the spiritual energy in the outside world is generally very rare. Several immortal masters are away from home and practice in poor conditions. They have not been exposed to such rich spiritual energy for a long time, which is why they seem so intoxicated.
Except for immortal cultivators who have practiced immortal cultivation techniques, ordinary people cannot absorb and refine spiritual energy, but it cannot be said that spiritual energy is useless to ordinary people. If they live in a place with stronger spiritual energy for a long time, ordinary people's physical fitness and various abilities will be subtly improved. It's just that this process is too slow, and it is difficult for ordinary people to detect it. That is to say, these people in the world have sensitive perceptions and are exposed to such a rich spiritual energy for the first time, so they have that illusion.
Seeing that the cracks had appeared and it was almost noon, Immortal Master Xi Ying from behind shouted: "Others, get out of the way, Xi Ping and Xi Ning take action together!"
Everyone didn't understand what the immortal masters were going to do, but they also knew that they couldn't neglect it, so they quickly took a few steps back and gave up the middle position to the three immortal masters.
At this moment, Immortal Master Xiping made a move with his right hand, and a small golden flying sword appeared in his palm. The flying sword rose in the wind, and in a blink of an eye it became more than a foot long, golden and shining brightly. Then Immortal Master Xiping waved his hand, and thenThe golden flying sword seemed to be alive, and it actually slashed towards the crack.
At the same time, Immortal Master Xi Ning on the other side also summoned a red oil lamp. No one knew what he did. The oil lamp buzzed softly and lit up a red flame. Immortal Master Xining then blew lightly on the oil lamp, and the red flame immediately flew to the crack, and the entire crack began to burn.
Seeing this scene in front of them, Qingyang and other people in the world were dumbfounded. They could control flying swords and make fire from a distance. Isn't this amazing? No wonder everyone is so envious of immortal masters. These methods are really powerful, and they are no worse than the legendary gods.
The red flame was so far away that everyone could feel the scorching temperature above it. If it came into contact with even a trace, it would probably be burned to ashes in the blink of an eye. As for the golden flying sword, it was so powerful. It carried a strong murderous aura. It would kill anyone who touched it or wiped it. Faced with this method, people in the world were completely powerless to resist, and there was no point in escaping. Seeing all this, Qingyang's heart became increasingly hot.
The crack seemed to be very elastic. He was hit by the flying sword and the flame at the same time. He just swung lightly to remove most of the attacks. The remaining force only increased the width of the crack by less than a finger width. Afterwards, as the attack power was lost, the crack began to slowly heal again.
At this moment, Immortal Master Xiying took out both palms and quickly performed a complex magic formula. A ball of cyan energy formed in his hands, and then he flicked it and hit the crack.
Immortal Master Xiying's skill is indeed powerful. Although he only attacks with his bare hands without using any weapons, the power is greater than the two Immortal Masters Xiping and Xining combined. With just such a palm, the crack widens to two inches wide.
Immortal Master Xiying's attack had just been completed, and the attacks of the other two Immortal Masters followed one after another. They divided into two groups and launched attacks continuously, without giving the crack a chance to recover. Before long, the crack gradually expanded to more than a foot wide, enough for a person to walk through.
By this time, Immortal Master Xiying was in better condition, Immortal Master Xiping and Immortal Xining were already sweating on their foreheads, and more than half of their energy had been consumed. After all, their cultivation level is lower and not enough to support their long-term consumption.
Once again it was Master Xiying's turn to attack, but this time he did not launch an attack. Instead, he took out two black seeds and threw them in front of him. Then two vines as thick as arms suddenly grew out. The vines grew bigger and bigger, and gradually stretched into the crack. Then countless branches appeared on the two vines, entangled and pulled each other, tearing at the crack.
As the vines grew, Immortal Master Xiying's face finally showed a hint of paleness. This was a sign of excessive consumption of vitality. It can be seen that controlling the growth of the vines and holding up the crack in front was also very labor-intensive for someone like Immortal Master Xiying.
(End of chapter)
